MECHANISM: Homogeneous affine query/key scale gauge

HYPOTHESIS: Normalizing the second head’s biased anchor query across its relative weights and bias, while transferring the omitted scale into the matching key row, will reduce the qualified 1484-parameter design to 1483 parameters while retaining at least 99% accuracy.

INTENDED_EDIT: Reproduce Reference Design 3’s normalized first-head frame and leading final-gain sharing, then remove one exact scale redundancy from the second-head anchor query’s complete affine row.

EVIDENCE: Reference Design 3 reached 99.8% at 1484 parameters; prior 1483 failures imposed additional terminal-affine sharing constraints, whereas this change uses an expressivity-preserving query/key gauge analogous to the successful normalized attention rows.
